summary: A container may use more than its request if the node has spare resources but never more than its limit; for example a 256 MiB request on an idle 8 GiB node can use more, while a 4 GiB limit is enforced and exceeding memory triggers an OOM kill. Limits are applied reactively or by enforcement depending on the runtime.
questions: Can a container use more memory than its request?
What happens when a container exceeds its memory limit?
Why was my AAP job pod OOM killed?
